articles.summary: As part of our ongoing commitment to innovation and customer-centric solutions, nVent SCHROFF is transitioning its Network and Colocation cabinet offering to the Varistar CP platform. Network cabinets and Colocation cabinets are now available as customizable configurations within the Varistar CP platform.
articles.title: nVent SCHROFF Network and Colocation Cabinets Now Available as Customizable Varistar CP Solutions

articles.summary: nVent SCHROFF Launches Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) Campaign to Accelerate Innovation in Real-Time TestingStraubenhardt, Germany – [July 4th, 2025] — nVent SCHROFF, a global leader in electronic systems protection and integration, is proud to announce the launch of its first-ever Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) Campaign — a multi-channel initiative focused on showcasing advanced infrastructure solutions for real-time simulation and testing environments. Powering the Future of Embedded System Validation
articles.title: Accelerate Innovation in Real-Time Testing with Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL)
